Eve (Auditor): Need SOC2 evidence for CMK rotation on 2026-01-15. Request: old->new key mapping, example S3 object versions showing SSEKMS KeyId, CloudTrail ReEncrypt/RotateKey records, IAM role snapshots before/after, and whether any vuln/incident overlapped. One-paragraph narrative please. Due EOD tomorrow.

Priya (security): Ack. I'll pull rotation CloudTrail and IAM snapshots. Tagging @Dan for S3 metadata and @Sam for incident/vuln check.

Dan (infra): Running quick queries now. Will return 5 object versions with head-object output including SSEKMSKeyId. CLI snippet used:
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts-prod --key models/v1/model.pt --version-id <VID>
# capture ServerSideEncryption, SSEKMSKeyId, Metadata
```
I'll mark any versions showing rewrap activity.

Sam (oncall): Checked alerts & incident tickets: none active in window. JIRA shows low-sev RDW-620 (dependency) not related. I pulled CloudTrail for ReEncrypt/EnableKeyRotation events in window.

Priya (security): Rotation mapping present: old arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/old-1 -> new arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/new-2 at 2026-01-15T02:31:10Z. Principal: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/key-ops.

Eve (Auditor): If any objects were re-encrypted, list job id and versions. Also include policy diff for role snapshots.

Dan (infra): Found one background rewrap job (rewrap-001) that re-encrypted 4 objects at 2026-01-15T04:02Z. CloudTrail shows ReEncrypt for those version ids. Will flag them in CSV.

artifact-bot: evidence-job-7965432100 started by @Priya (security) progress: collecting cloudtrail, s3 metadata, iam snapshots

Priya (security): I'll bundle:
- kms_rotation_cloudtrail_20260115.csv
- s3_versions_kms_metadata_20260115.csv (rewrap flag)
- iam_role_snapshots_diff_20260115.txt
- narrative_20260115.txt (one paragraph)
Upload to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2026-01-15/ and post link here.

artifact-bot: evidence-job-7965432100 complete. presigned link: https://redwood-files.example/7965432100/proof.zip (7 days)

Eve (Auditor): Received. Thanks — I'll review and let you know if more detail needed.
